subject: results/uarch/qwen_rom_kv_credit17_20261003/model-r3.json (calendar = model-r2.json)
method: Scratch worktree at origin/main; tools/uarch_model_qwen_kv_credit17.build() re-run with (a) string edits to the credit17 calendar source adding ECC edges, (b) PCService subclasses for strict REFab / strict REFpb. Baseline replay reproduces model-r2 exactly (358.6013 us, REF=PREALL=11456, max lateness 1633).

A_mutable_storage_protection.named_baseline: QROM-KV-SECDED-B1: SECDED (extended Hamming, tools/mem_compiler/ecc.py / rtl/dft/ot_rom_secded_dec.sv construction) on every mutable SRAM word and on FF arrays that hold data records; even parity on control FF state; encode-on-write, isolated clean-check-on-read (1 edge), held-word slow correction off the fast path (repo dsrom clean-checker contract). Mirrors GPU practice (SECDED on RF/SMEM/L2/HBM data; detect-only parity on re-issuable control).

codes.FF spill 4/PC and 16 lookahead/PC: carry the same RAM codewords unchanged (+19 FF/record); checked after the RAM/spill join
codes.assembly pools 56x85x787 FF: 4 x (153,144) per 128-data+16-mask quarter (quarter-write granularity, no RMW) + (220,211) meta = +45 FF/word
codes.pending keys/cohort/credit/pointer contr: even parity per entry or per <=32 bits (detect -> fail-stop/replay; HBM reads idempotent)

A_mutable_storage_protection.code_width_justification: K=256 payload code reuses the repo-measured K=256 checker exactly; header/context K<=247 need 8+1 bits; all three macro words have >=15 spare bits, so (523,512)-style full-word codes are unnecessary and (72,64) would cost 8 codes/record with no coverage benefit for whole-record writes.

measured_cost_source.clean checker K=256 N=266: results/uarch/dsrom_secded_clean_checker_20261002/review.json: SS 525.73 ps, FF min 11.67 ps (virtual hold slack -13.3 ps -> hold buffers needed), 80.07 um2, 611 cells; SS setup slack +247.6 ps at 833 ps
measured_cost_source.full corrector K=256: results/uarch/dsrom_secded_fullwidth_characterization_20261002/review.json: 158.64 um2, SS 2795 ps unbuffered (fanout 221) -> off fast path, registered 3-stage option only
measured_cost_source.note: ROM ECC evidence is preserved history (AGENTS ROM policy); reused here only as measured ASAP7 cost of the same SECDED construction for SRAM/FF.

area_mm2_per_die.scope: cell area only, FF 0.42282 um2 (model-r3), logic scaled per bit from measured K=256 cones; encoder priced = checker (conservative). Excludes hold buffers, PG/route/clock, macro read-energy.

conservative.detail: return: +1 encode at raw capture (3->4), +1 SECDED check at return RAM/spill read (validation 2->3), +1 check on context read (lookup 12->13); request: +1 encode at request-RAM write, +1 check before command (arrival->command 10->12); assembly: +1 encode at quarter write, +1 check at pool read (4->6 stream periods). Reverse validation unchanged (FF parity, 0 edges).

lower_bound.detail: encoders absorbed in existing capture/ingress stages, request check overlapped with the 10-edge arrival->command minimum; only the return-RAM check and assembly-read check exposed

latency_per_transaction.lands_on: Yes: adds edges to raw_capture (encode) and return_validation (check) and the 12-edge lookup; all sit on the calendar ready = col+25000+capture+validation+lookup+link chain that gates cohort retirement and credit return.

token_effect.critical_path_estimate: 2.674 us / 36 layers = 74 ns/layer = ~11 serial transactions x 6.67 ns per layer; consistent with Little: 2084 cohorts / 136 credits = 15.3 credit turns per layer, ~73% exposed.
token_effect.note: ecclow is 0.098 us FASTER than baseline: the lazy-refresh calendar is not monotone in latency (refresh placement moves); treat lower bound as ~0.

repo_sources.tRFCpb: 200 ns, JESD238 Table 93 via Ramulator2 72427a1 — rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hbm.sv:33,110; tREFIpb=tREFI/32
repo_sources.mode used by credit17: all-bank REFab per PC: PREALL (+17 tRP) then REF, 350 block, staggered 3900+3900*pc/32 (tools/uarch_model_qwen_kv_successor.py:104-131; RTL rtl/model_ready_hbm_r14/ot_hbm_r14_pc.sv:58,98,120,150,158)
repo_sources.postponement allowance: NO repo source. The repo HBM RTL models state "there is no postpone/pull-in" (ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hbm.sv:36). External (not in repo, unverified here): JEDEC DDR4/HBM-class parts allow up to 8 REFab postponed (<=9 x tREFI between REFs); confirm against JESD238 before citing.

B_refresh.lazy_semantics: PCService only checks refresh when a NEW column arrives at that PC; an idle PC accrues debt until its next request, then pays PREALL+REF+tRFC on the demand path. 1633 edges is an observed maximum, not a bound; at token end 188 REFab (~1.5/PC) are due but never issued and the next token restarts the phase, silently forgiving the debt. The source RTL instead refreshes from IDLE when the queue is empty (ot_hbm_r14_pc.sv:120).

legality_of_1633.verdict: Within any postponement allowance >=1 REF if the end-of-token debt is carried; but no repo source states the allowance, and the lazy model provides no bound for idle PCs, so it cannot be qualified as legal from repo evidence.

strict_REFab.definition: REF issued at its due edge (bounded only by PREALL/tRP, lastcol+2, refblock and shared command-path legality), i.e. the RTL idle-refresh behaviour
strict_REFab.token_end_debt_note: steady-state carry of the ~1.5 REF/PC debt adds at most one PREALL+tRFC (367 edges) per PC early in the next token; upper bound +0.367 us/token if fully exposed (not run).
strict_REFab.why_faster: lazy refresh places PREALL+tRFC at the arrival of demand (on the critical path); strict refresh places it in idle gaps.

strict_REFpb_naive.verdict: REJECTED as priced: round-robin REFpb at due time closes open rows (PRE 4644->183890) and adds 431k commands on the 4 shared command paths/stack; a refresh-aware bank choice (repo REFPB=2/3) was not modelled.

like_for_like_1pct_screen.verdict: The 1.29% gain of credit17+strict over the LAZY predecessor is an artifact; like-for-like it is 0.20% (0.02% with ECC). 1% gate still FAILS; 3k budget (333.33 us) missed by ~23.8 us.

remaining_unpriced: hold-fix buffers for checker min paths (-13.3 ps virtual)
